title: Weld Re 8 School District — claimed by thegentlemen
description: US · Education · weld8.org Weld Re-8 School District public school district founded in 1914 in Fort Lupton, Colorado, serving about 2500 students across 7 schools with a 43.5 million dollar budget. The student body is 76 percent minority with over half on free lunch, and academics are weak, math proficiency 16 to 19 percent, reading 22 to 26 percent, far below state averages.
